_comment: Project-shared Claude Code settings, committed; personal additions go in .claude/settings.local.json (git-ignored). Hooks: the current state is printed into every new session; a warning fires if Claude Code is about to compact. Permissions: the project's routine commands run without prompts (each python3 rule has a python twin for Windows, where python3 is the Microsoft Store alias); force-pushes are refused.

hooks.command: if [ -f docs/STATE.md ]; then echo '=== docs/STATE.md (current state; /resume to continue, /handoff before stopping) ==='; cat docs/STATE.md; fi
echo 'Compaction is starting. This project avoids compaction: run /handoff, then open a fresh session and /resume.'
